Package org.apache.hadoop.hbase.master.assignment

Class RegionInTransitionTracker

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.hbase.master.assignment.RegionInTransitionTracker
@Private public class RegionInTransitionTracker extends Object
Tracks regions that are currently in transition (RIT) - those not yet in their terminal state.

    • isRegionInTransition

    • regionCrashed

      public void regionCrashed(RegionStateNode regionStateNode, long crashTime)
      Handles a region whose hosting RegionServer has crashed. When a RegionServer fails, all regions it was hosting are automatically added to the RIT list since they need to be reassigned to other servers.
      Parameters:
      regionStateNode - the region whose hosting server crashed
      crashTime - the RIT start time to use when the region is not already in transition (an existing entry keeps its earlier start). Passed explicitly rather than read from RegionStateNode.getLastUpdate(), which a stale procedure can mask. A non-positive value falls back to the node's last update.

    • handleRegionStateNodeOperation

      public void handleRegionStateNodeOperation(RegionStateNode regionStateNode)
      Processes a region state change and updates the RIT tracking accordingly. This is the core method that determines whether a region should be added to or removed from the RIT list based on its current state and the table's enabled/disabled status. This method should be called whenever a region state changes get stored to hbase:meta Note: Only default replicas (replica ID 0) are tracked. Read replicas are ignored.
      Parameters:
      regionStateNode - the region state node with the current state information

    • handleRegionDelete

      public void handleRegionDelete(RegionInfo regionInfo)
      Handles the deletion of a region by removing it from RIT tracking. This is called when a region is permanently removed from the cluster, typically after a successful merge operation where the parent regions are cleaned up. During table deletion, table should be already disabled and all the region are already OFFLINE
      Parameters:
      regionInfo - the region being deleted
